description: NaMgMn₂O₄ is Caswellsilverite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with six MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-10°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.37 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-11°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.27 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-11°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.36 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with six MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-10°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.31 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Mg, and three Mn atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaMg₂Mn₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and three Mn atoms to form ONa₂MgMn₃ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONa₂MgMn₃ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₂Mn₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
